title: Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message

entities.name: SidelinkUEInformationNR transmission procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE transmits SidelinkUEInformationNR message to indicate interests, request resources, or report failures related to NR sidelink communication, discovery, and relay operations.

entities.name: SidelinkUEInformationNR message
entities.description: RRC message used by UE to report sidelink-related information including interests, resource requests, and failure reports to the network.

entities.name: sl-RxInterestedFreqList
entities.description: Information element indicating frequencies for NR sidelink communication reception.

entities.name: sl-TxResourceReqList
entities.description: Information element containing resource requests for NR sidelink communication transmission.

entities.name: sl-FailureList
entities.description: Information element reporting sidelink radio link failures or RRC reconfiguration failures.

entities.name: sl-RxInterestedFreqListDisc
entities.description: Information element indicating frequencies for NR sidelink discovery announcements reception.

entities.name: sl-TxResourceReqListDis
entities.description: Information element containing resource requests for NR sidelink discovery announcements transmission.

entities.name: sl-TxResourceReqListCommRelay
entities.description: Information element containing resource requests for NR sidelink relay communication transmission.

entities.name: ue-Type
entities.description: Information element indicating UE type (relayUE or remoteUE) for sidelink relay operations.

entities.name: SIB12 including sl-ConfigCommonNR provided by PCell
entities.description: Condition where System Information Block 12 with sidelink configuration is provided by the primary cell.

entities.name: Configured by upper layers to receive NR sidelink communication
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured by upper layers to receive NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: Configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink communication
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: Sidelink radio link failure or RRC reconfiguration failure declared
entities.description: Condition where sidelink radio link failure or sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure has been declared.

relations.description: The procedure involves transmitting the SidelinkUEInformationNR message.
Message contains sl-RxInterestedFreqList IE when UE is configured to receive sidelink communication.
Message contains sl-TxResourceReqList IE when UE is configured to transmit sidelink communication.
Message contains sl-FailureList IE when sidelink failure is declared.
Message contains sl-RxInterestedFreqListDisc IE when UE is configured to receive sidelink discovery announcements.
Message contains sl-TxResourceReqListDis IE when UE is configured to transmit sidelink discovery announcements.
Message contains sl-TxResourceReqListCommRelay IE when UE is configured for sidelink relay communication.
Message contains ue-Type IE to indicate relayUE or remoteUE for sidelink relay operations.
Inclusion of sl-RxInterestedFreqList is guarded by SIB12 being provided.
Inclusion of sl-RxInterestedFreqList is guarded by UE being configured to receive sidelink communication.
Inclusion of sl-TxResourceReqList is guarded by UE being configured to transmit sidelink communication.
Inclusion of sl-FailureList is guarded by sidelink failure being declared.
